title: French Braised Cherry Tomato Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with braised cherry tomatoes, perfect for a cold evening. This dish is a twist on the classic French stew, adapted to be vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it's translucent, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the canned braised tomatoes, vegetable broth, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine, then bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
